اذلوليت (form XII)
# اِذْلَوْلَيْتُ (iḏlawlaytu) /ið.law.laj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِذْلَوْلَى (iḏlawlā)
# اِذْلَوْلَيْتَ (iḏlawlayta) /ið.law.laj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِذْلَوْلَى (iḏlawlā)
# اِذْلَوْلَيْتِ (iḏlawlayti) /ið.law.laj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِذْلَوْلَى (iḏlawlā)
